prompt: Which statements about project views are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Views are lenses, not copies: many views, each with its own layout and slicing, over one shared set of items. The "one board per project" world ended when views arrived.

options.text: A project can have multiple saved views
Each view can use a different layout, such as table, board, or roadmap
Each view can group, sort, and filter differently
Every project is limited to a single board layout
Views are separate copies of the items
